solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Where speed restricted by a third in Dibden Purlieu, at turning

indicators.note: third in asks for the third letter of the village's first name
turning signals that the gathered letters are spun round into a new order

explanation.surface: A note on a speed limit somewhere in a Hampshire village, Dibden Purlieu, at a bend in the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'third in' picks B from Dibden; A, B, PURLIEU and AT are rearranged, signalled by 'turning'. Dibden Purlieu is a real village in Hampshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a town or village zone with lower limits on vehicle speed is officially termed this kind of developed district.

clue.text: Poor in Knock denied pence

indicators.note: denied means the word for a knock goes without the coin abbreviation

parts.note: a bump is a knock or blow
P is the abbreviation for pence in British money

explanation.surface: A hard-up person refused the pennies they asked for at the door.
explanation.definitionFit: As an informal adjective it means of poor quality, as in a dud or worthless deal.

clue.text: Film director's beginning to go red

indicators.note: beginning to go says the first letter of the director's name is dropped

parts.note: Michael Winner was a British film director, known for Death Wish

explanation.surface: A film director's opening scene turns everything red.
explanation.walkthrough: Michael Winner, director of the Death Wish films, loses his W.
explanation.definitionFit: On an archery target the red ring close to the gold centre is called by this name for the inside part.

clue.text: Solicitor eats one half of meal in break

indicators.note: eats has the word for a solicitor swallowing the other pieces

parts.note: a tout is someone who solicits custom
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: half of takes the first two of the four letters of meal

explanation.surface: A lawyer bolts down half his lunch during a short break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' suggests a lawyer, but here it is a tout, someone touting for business.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause or interval in play or work is a synonym for a break.

clue.text: No place as rowdy as Floridian location

indicators.note: rowdy suggests the letters of the first three words are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A boast that nowhere is as boisterous as a certain town in Florida.
explanation.definitionFit: Pensacola is a city in the Florida panhandle, so it is a place in that US state.

clue.text: Criticize Prospero as tiresome part

indicators.note: part says the letters lie within a stretch of the words Prospero as tiresome

explanation.surface: A critic pans Prospero, the magician in The Tempest, as a tedious role.
explanation.definitionFit: To slate or tear into someone harshly, especially in jest or a review, is this verb.

clue.text: Chagrin provoked in making bow

indicators.note: provoked suggests the letters of the word chagrin are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone annoyed and stirred up while having to take a bow.
explanation.definitionFit: Curving into a bow shape is a synonym for bending in a curve.

clue.text: In centre, appear with deadly beggar

indicators.note: In centre asks for the two middle letters of the word appear

explanation.surface: A dangerous beggar turns up in the middle of things.
explanation.walkthrough: Blind Pew is the menacing blind beggar in Robert Louis Stevenson's Treasure Island who delivers the black spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The threatening blind mendicant in Treasure Island bears this name, so the definition is a literary allusion.

clue.text: Sweet fruit for each male zealous apostle entertains

parts.note: per means for each, as in a price per head

indicators.note: entertains has the apostle's name hosting the abbreviation for male

parts.note: Simon the Zealot was one of the twelve apostles

explanation.surface: Fruit for every man that an eager apostle offers to guests.
explanation.definitionFit: The orange persimmon is a sweet soft fruit, eaten when fully ripe.

clue.text: Craft holds king and staff in profound admiration

indicators.note: holds has the word for deep admiration gripping the other pieces

parts.note: worship is profound admiration
K is the chess abbreviation for king
to man a place is to staff it

explanation.surface: A crafted object containing a king and his staff, all deeply admired.
explanation.definitionFit: Craft as skill in making things is a synonym for the quality of a maker's work.

clue.text: Girl involves Arab in obsession

indicators.note: involves has the girl's name wrapping round the other piece

parts.note: Mona is a girl's name
an Omani is an Arab from Oman

explanation.surface: A girl drawing an Arab man into her fixation.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixation on one single subject is the psychological sense of this word.

clue.text: Elderly assistant perhaps about to enter saloon?

indicators.note: to enter puts the short word for about into the vehicle

parts.note: a saloon is a type of car (sedan)
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An old helper about to step into a bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'saloon' looks like a bar but is the British name for a sedan car; 'Elderly assistant' is one who helps the elderly, not an old helper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who looks after an old or infirm person is an example of this kind of helper.

clue.text: Doctor boarding for South Africa and island republic

indicators.note: boarding has the doctor climbing aboard between the other pieces

parts.note: MO is a medical officer

explanation.surface: A doctor getting on a ship for South Africa and an island state.
explanation.definitionFit: Formosa is the old Portuguese-derived name for Taiwan, the island seat of the Republic of China.

clue.text: Initial advantage Wrights gave us?

definitions.meaning: an early lead at the outset of a contest
the Wright brothers launched powered aviation, so they gave us the beginning of air travel

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a beginning in the air, figuratively an early lead; the Wright brothers' first powered aeroplane flights provide the joke.

clue.text: Identical notes about right uranium mass: it's radioactive stuff

indicators.note: about has the first of the two notes going round the abbreviation for right

parts.note: TI is a note of the sol-fa scale, given twice
U is the chemical symbol for uranium
M is the symbol for mass in physics

explanation.surface: A physics note: uranium mass, and identical readings, all radioactive.
explanation.definitionFit: Tritium is the radioactive isotope of hydrogen, so it is a radioactive substance.

clue.text: Yen to join German eight in fast boat

parts.note: Y is the abbreviation for the yen, Japan's currency
acht is the German word for eight

explanation.surface: A desire to join a German rowing eight in a speedy vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eight' suggests a rowing crew, but it is the number in German.
explanation.definitionFit: A light sailing or racing vessel is a yacht; 'fast' fits a racing one.

clue.text: Fresh garlic tea that lets joints move freely

indicators.note: Fresh hints at the letters of garlic tea being made anew in another order

explanation.surface: A herbal remedy of garlic tea said to free up stiff joints.
explanation.definitionFit: The smooth tissue lining joints lets bones glide over each other, so it eases movement.

clue.text: One to march or stroll with old woman, breaking leg

indicators.note: breaking has the other pieces split the cricket word for leg in two

parts.note: on is the leg side in cricket
to range is to roam or wander
ma is an informal word for mother, one's old woman

explanation.surface: Someone who could either march or wander about with his mother, despite a broken leg.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on side and leg side are the same half of the field. Orangemen, members of the Protestant Orange Order of Northern Ireland, are known for their July marches.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Orange Order famously parade each July, so this is one who marches.

clue.text: Sailor given lash inside fashion house? I give up!

parts.note: AB is an able seaman

indicators.note: inside places the whip within the fashion house's name

parts.note: Dior is a Paris fashion house
cat as in cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip

explanation.surface: A sailor flogged inside a couture house throws in the towel.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the cry of one who renounces something, such as a throne.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who gives up a throne or office could fairly say these words, so the definition is a speaker's cry.

clue.text: Daughter accompanies mysterious Sumerian nanny

indicators.note: mysterious suggests the letters of Sumerian are obscured by being jumbled

explanation.surface: A daughter goes along with a puzzling nanny from ancient Sumer.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman employed to look after children is a nanny, a synonym.

clue.text: Piece that comforts listener from Scots, picked up on circuit

indicators.note: picked up in a down clue means the Scots word is read upwards

parts.note: frae is Scots for from
a lap is one circuit of a track

explanation.surface: Some soothing music for a listener from Scotland, heard while on tour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'listener' is an ear, not a member of an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: A flap of a cap that covers the ear keeps the hearing organ warm, so it comforts it.

clue.text: Scream he produced, almost stabbed by knight

indicators.note: stabbed by has the chess abbreviation for knight piercing the other word

parts.note: much means almost, as in much the same
N is the chess abbreviation for knight

explanation.surface: A scream he let out when nearly stabbed by a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Edvard Munch, the Norwegian painter, painted The Scream.

clue.text: Order two parts needed for a friend?

parts.words: two parts needed for a friend?
parts.note: a word for a friend, mate; join them with the word linking two parts

explanation.surface: An instruction listing two things required to make a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: The cryptic part reads as 'M and ATE', the two parts of MATE (friend).
explanation.definitionFit: An official command or authority to act is a synonym for an order.

clue.text: Little girl in factory sent back poor parts

indicators.note: sent back means the whole combination is read right to left
in puts the short girl's name inside the factory word

parts.note: a works is a factory
Di is a short form of Diana, a little girl's name

explanation.surface: A child working in a factory sent home from the slums.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little girl' tempts the solver to try KID, but here it is a pet name; 'sent back' turns the whole combination, WORDIKS, round.
explanation.definitionFit: Skid Row is a run-down district where down-and-outs live, so a poor area of a city.

clue.text: Youngster needs encouragement after sorrow, ultimately

indicators.note: after puts the support word behind that final letter
ultimately points to the final letter of sorrow

parts.note: help is support or encouragement

explanation.surface: A child who needs cheering up after a sad time.
explanation.definitionFit: A puppy or cub is a young animal, and by extension a cheeky youngster.

clue.text: Spell has power to wrong-foot

parts.note: can means is able to, has the power to
to trip someone is to wrong-foot them

explanation.surface: A magic charm able to make someone stumble.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantrip is a Scots word for a witch's charm or magic spell.

clue.text: Sorry about official decision that excludes fifty

indicators.note: that excludes means the Roman numeral for fifty is left out

parts.note: a ruling is an official decision
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Regret over a referee's call that rules out fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: Regretting something is being sorry about it, a synonym phrase.

clue.text: Use excellent line with King James Bible

parts.note: AV is the Authorised Version, the King James Bible
A1 means excellent, written as AI

explanation.surface: Putting an excellent line from the King James Bible to work.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, benefit or usefulness, as in 'to no avail'.

clue.text: Send back additional mould: about time!

parts.note: extra means additional

indicators.note: about has the shaping tool around the abbreviation for time

parts.note: a die is a mould for shaping metal

explanation.surface: Someone shouting to return the extra mould, finally.
explanation.definitionFit: To hand an accused person back to another country for trial is a legal synonym.

clue.text: Little creature went without starter

indicators.note: without starter means the first letter of the word for went is dropped

parts.note: left means went away, departed

explanation.surface: A small creature that departed without its first course.
explanation.definitionFit: An eft is a young newt, a small amphibian.

clue.text: Moor one to stop the Arabian Lawrence?

indicators.note: to stop has the numeral plugging the gap between the initials

parts.note: T. E. Lawrence was Lawrence of Arabia
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A Moorish man halting Lawrence of Arabia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moor' suggests a North African, but it is the verb to secure a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To secure a boat with ropes is to fasten it, a synonym for the verb.

clue.text: Journal with influence that keeps work down

parts.note: a journal is a newspaper, a paper
weight means influence, as in carry weight

explanation.surface: A publication with clout that suppresses work.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy object placed on documents stops loose sheets blowing away, so it holds work down.
